name: Osakabe Kanade
source:
A distant relative of Sota's who is living at his house after enrolling in Seirei Academy.

With his androgynous looks and effortlessly cute behavior, he seems to awaken a sense of maternal instinct, putting him under the protective and attentive care of the female cast—much to his extreme displeasure. He hates dirty jokes and refuses to go along with typical "guy humor," which leaves Sota somewhat dissatisfied. He serves as the student council vice president and frequently hangs out with Koharu.

Favorite things: Games, spicy food
Disliked things: Girls, dirty jokes, horror

[Translated from the [url=https://whirlpool.co.jp/sprinkle/character/chara6.php#chara-main]official website[/url]]
